description: Auditable equity research and fail-closed broker execution for US and Indian cash equities.
name: io.github.akira231097/artha-council

environmentVariables.description: Market profile: US or IN.
environmentVariables.name: ARTHA_MCP_MARKET

environmentVariables.description: Broker adapter: snapshot, upstox, zerodha, none, or plugin.
environmentVariables.name: ARTHA_MCP_BROKER

environmentVariables.description: Research boundary: embedded, host_orchestrated, or plugin. India should use host_orchestrated or a market-native plugin.
environmentVariables.name: ARTHA_MCP_RESEARCH_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Persistent directory for journals, receipts, jobs, portfolio state, and audit artifacts.
environmentVariables.name: ARTHA_MCP_DATA_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Capability mode: read_only, operator, or trading. Defaults to read_only.
environmentVariables.name: ARTHA_MCP_ACCESS_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Explicit operations switch. Defaults to false.
environmentVariables.name: ARTHA_MCP_OPERATIONS_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: Explicit live-trading switch. Defaults to false.
environmentVariables.name: ARTHA_MCP_TRADING_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: Final MCP placement kill switch. Defaults to true.
environmentVariables.name: ARTHA_MCP_KILL_SWITCH

environmentVariables.description: Maximum value of one order in the selected market currency. Defaults to 25 USD or 2500 INR.
environmentVariables.name: ARTHA_MCP_MAX_ORDER_VALUE

environmentVariables.description: Maximum total daily order value in the selected market currency. Defaults to 50 USD or 5000 INR.
environmentVariables.name: ARTHA_MCP_MAX_DAILY_ORDER_VALUE

environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of broker placements per market day. Defaults to 2.
environmentVariables.name: ARTHA_MCP_MAX_DAILY_ORDERS

environmentVariables.description: Maximum queued or running allowlisted workflows. Defaults to 8 and prevents an unbounded work queue.
environmentVariables.name: ARTHA_MCP_MAX_PENDING_JOBS

environmentVariables.description: Optional Financial Modeling Prep key for embedded US research.
environmentVariables.name: FMP_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional Finnhub key for embedded US research enrichment.
environmentVariables.name: FINNHUB_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional Google Gemini key for embedded Council roles and web-grounded research.
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional Telegram bot token for Artha notifications.
environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Optional Telegram destination used with TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.
environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Upstox live account/read token used for portfolio, quote, margin, and fee proof.
environmentVariables.name: UPSTOX_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Separate Upstox sandbox token, required only when ARTHA_UPSTOX_SANDBOX=true.
environmentVariables.name: UPSTOX_SANDBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Operator attestation that this deployment IP is registered with the selected Indian broker.
environmentVariables.name: ARTHA_INDIA_STATIC_IP_REGISTERED

environmentVariables.description: Operator attestation that required demat authorization is valid for Indian delivery sells.
environmentVariables.name: ARTHA_INDIA_DEMAT_SELL_AUTHORIZED

environmentVariables.description: Optional exchange-approved algo name configured in the Upstox app.
environmentVariables.name: ARTHA_UPSTOX_ALGO_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Required only for the Zerodha adapter.
environmentVariables.name: KITE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Required only for the Zerodha adapter.
environmentVariables.name: KITE_ACCESS_TOKEN

title: Artha Council
